children: A Derive governance proposal (DIP) is live to raise the share of protocol fees allocated to weekly DRV buybacks from 35% to 50%. The existing buyback mechanism and cadence remain unchanged, and community review is open.

If approved, the change directs a larger portion of protocol revenue into recurring DRV purchases while keeping the weekly schedule intact. The proposal modifies only the allocation percentage, so execution details such as timing and method stay as they are. Community review is open, meaning DRV holders can examine the terms and vote before the adjustment takes effect. The outcome depends on governance participation, and the current 35% allocation continues until the proposal passes.
A new governance proposal to increase the allocation of protocol revenue to DRV buybacks to 50% is live on the Derive forum.
Community members can review the proposed increase and share their views.

title: Derive: DIP proposes raising weekly DRV buyback fee share from 35% to 50% - 24 Sep 2026
